tasks.title: Parse @project:task-id in DependsOn (Cross-project task dependencies)
tasks.description: DependsOn accepts @project:task-id and resolves it to the named sub-project.

tasks.title: Validate cross-project DAGs (Cross-project task dependencies)
tasks.description: Cycle detection and readiness checks span sub-projects, so a cross-project cycle is refused.

tasks.title: Readiness honours cross-project edges (Cross-project task dependencies)
tasks.description: A task blocked by another project is not reported ready, in CLI and MCP alike.

tasks.title: Define the dispatch contract (Per-task subagent dispatch)
tasks.description: A task handed to a subagent carries its spec citation, acceptance criteria, and the tool to report completion through.

tasks.title: Deterministic completion hook (Per-task subagent dispatch)
tasks.description: A dispatched task completes through a recorded transition, so the audit trail attributes the work to that agent and session.

tasks.title: Drift gate for CI (Spec-to-PR loop)
tasks.description: A documented CI job runs drift detect on merge and fails or reports based on severity.

tasks.title: Open a follow-up for unaccepted drift (Spec-to-PR loop)
tasks.description: Drift left unaccepted after merge becomes a tracked issue rather than a silent divergence.

tasks.title: Emit an explain-and-patch prompt (Drift explainer follow-ups)
tasks.description: roady drift explain can emit a request whose expected format is a patch, with the write-back tool named.

tasks.title: Declare member repositories (Cross-repo planning)
tasks.description: A workspace lists member repos and resolves their .roady/ directories.

tasks.title: Aggregate plan state across members (Cross-repo planning)
tasks.description: Status, report, and drift span every member repo in one view.
